title: About Moonlit Yard Scumble
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 72 recent saved-signal files and 69 captured links, then narrowed the page to 8 source windows around Anchor image material 2 and @ericsmith1302: Wife and I were discussing backyard renovations today, but a hard time..., plus 6 more. A source image from uploads7.wikiart.org helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Moonlit Yard Scumble: Moonlit backyard render scumble, fashion/material macro with shallow macro camera: dark bark and branch edges form a proscenium around a folded turf-and-hill plane, a tiny crescent pool-glint high in the field. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 8 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against ragged left bark aperture edge, pale triangular gable fracture across center-right, and turquoise rounded basin cut in right hillside.
